items.title: CVE-2026-132808: A malicious actor with access to the network and low privileges could exploit an Incorrect Authorization…
items.summary: A malicious actor with access to the network and low privileges could exploit an Incorrect Authorization vulnerability found in UniFi Access Application to execute arbitrary commands on certain adopted UniFi Access devices.

items.summary: A malicious actor with access to the network and under certain conditions could exploit an Improper Certificate Validation vulnerability found in UniFi Access Application to obtain sensitive information from and make unauthorized changes to an adopted UniFi Access device.

items.title: CVE-2026-132802: A malicious actor with access to the network and low privileges could exploit an Improper Link Resolution…

items.title: PHP Warns of Critical Security Flaws Affecting All Supported Versions, Fixes Coming November 19
items.summary: The maintainers of the PHP programming language on Wednesday issued an advisory announcing an upcoming security release that addresses critical flaws. The release is scheduled for November 19, 2026, between 2 and 2:30 p.m. UTC.

items.title: F5 BIG-IP flaws threaten traffic outages and possible remote code execution
items.summary: F5 BIG-IP manages and secures network traffic for applications. Six critical flaws in the platform could let unauthenticated attackers disrupt traffic and potentially execute code when virtual servers use specific configurations. F5 has issued engineering hotfixes but lists no workarounds for the six vulnerabilities.

items.title: Amazon CloudWatch simplifies network performance monitoring for your Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (VPC)
